LARSON'S GAME - HOW TO PLAY
===========================

Thanks for trying the game! It is still in development, so anything that
feels odd, confusing, slow or broken is exactly what Larson wants to hear.


WHAT YOU NEED
-------------
- Windows 10 or 11, macOS 11 (Big Sur) or newer, or Linux.
- About 9 GB of free disk space while you unzip (4.2 GB for the zip,
  4.2 GB for the game). You can delete the zip afterwards.
- 8 GB of memory (RAM) or more.
- A graphics chip from the last ten years or so (it needs OpenGL 3.3).
- Java 21 or newer (free, see step 1).


STEP 1 - INSTALL JAVA 21 (once)
-------------------------------
The game runs on Java. If you already have Java 21 or newer, skip this.
The launchers in step 3 check for you, and open the download page if
Java is missing.

  Windows: go to https://adoptium.net/temurin/releases/?version=21
           choose Windows, x64, and download the .msi. Run it and click
           Next through it (the default choices are fine).

  Mac:     go to https://adoptium.net/temurin/releases/?version=21
           choose macOS, and the .pkg for your Mac:
             - aarch64 for an Apple chip (M1, M2, M3, M4 ...)
             - x64 for an Intel Mac
           (Apple menu > About This Mac shows which one you have.)
           Open the .pkg and follow the installer.

  Linux:   Ubuntu, Debian, Mint:  sudo apt install openjdk-21-jre
           Fedora:                sudo dnf install java-21-openjdk
           Arch:                  sudo pacman -S jre21-openjdk


STEP 2 - UNZIP THE GAME
-----------------------
  Windows: right-click Larsons-Game.zip and choose "Extract All...".
           Don't just open the zip and double-click inside it - the game
           has to be unzipped first.
  Mac:     double-click Larsons-Game.zip.
  Linux:   unzip Larsons-Game.zip

You get a folder called Larsons-Game. Keep everything in it together -
the game needs the "assets" folder next to it. You can move the whole
folder anywhere you like (Documents, Desktop ...).


STEP 3 - START IT
-----------------
Open the Larsons-Game folder and double-click the file for your computer.
A small text window opens next to the game; leave it open while you play.

  Windows: "Play on Windows" (Play on Windows.bat)
           If Windows asks first ("Windows protected your PC", or "The
           publisher could not be verified"), click "More info" and then
           "Run anyway" (or just "Run"). It only asks the first time.

  Mac:     "Play on Mac" (Play on Mac.command)
           The first time, macOS says it can't check the file for
           malicious software. That is normal for a game shared between
           friends. To open it anyway:
             1. Click Done (or OK) on that message.
             2. Open System Settings > Privacy & Security, scroll down to
                the message about "Play on Mac.command" and click
                "Open Anyway" (then enter your password if it asks).
             On older macOS versions you can instead right-click the file
             (or Control-click it), choose Open, then Open again.
           After that it opens with a normal double-click. If macOS asks
           whether Terminal may access your Downloads (or Documents)
           folder, click OK - that is where the game's files are.

  Linux:   in a terminal, in the Larsons-Game folder:
             ./"Play on Linux.sh"

The first start shows a loading screen for a few seconds up to a minute
while the game reads its 1.5 million sprite pictures. Then:

  1. In the main menu, choose Play > Demo.
  2. Pick a class (Mage, Knight, Rogue ...). You can change it later in
     the pause menu.
  3. You start as a plain stand-in figure. Press Esc and open Wardrobe to
     choose your character's body, face and hair. More clothes, armour
     and dyes are found in the world and in chests.


CONTROLS (the basics)
---------------------
  W A S D              walk (relative to the camera)
  Shift / Ctrl         run / sprint (while moving)
  Space                jump
  C                    crouch / stand up
  Left Alt or Z        dodge: tap to dash, hold to roll
  Left click or F      attack (in the air: a jump attack)
  X / R / Q            heavy attack / spin attack / parry
  B (hold) / V         block / shield bash
  L                    lock on to the nearest enemy (L again to let go)
  1 - 5, mouse wheel   choose what is in your hands (the hotbar)
  I                    inventory
  J                    your class cards
  E                    pick up, open chests, go through doors, shop,
                       ride a horse ... whatever is nearest
  G                    drop what you are holding
  Right mouse drag     turn the camera (also the arrow keys)
  + / -                zoom in / out
  Tab                  camera height: side, 45 degrees, top-down
  F11                  full screen on / off
  F12                  screenshot (saved in the "screenshots" folder)
  Esc                  pause menu: settings, sounds, the full list of
                       controls, and quit

  In deep water you swim: C dives under, Space comes back up.
  Walk into vines on a cliff to climb them.


SENDING FEEDBACK TO LARSON
--------------------------
- What you liked, what confused you, what felt too hard or too easy.
- Screenshots: press F12 in the game. They are saved in the
  "screenshots" folder inside the Larsons-Game folder.
- If something went wrong, send the file "latest.log" from the "logs"
  folder inside the Larsons-Game folder (the run before that one is
  "previous.log"). It has everything the game printed, which helps
  Larson find the problem.


IF SOMETHING GOES WRONG
-----------------------
"needs Java 21" even though you installed it:
    restart the computer and try again. If it still says so, uninstall
    any old Java versions or install Temurin 21 from step 1.

The game is slow or choppy on a Windows laptop:
    many laptops have two graphics chips and give Java the slower one.
    Open Settings > System > Display > Graphics, click "Browse" (or
    "Add desktop app"), pick java.exe - usually in
    C:\Program Files\Eclipse Adoptium\jdk-21...\bin (or jre-21...) -
    then click it, choose Options > High performance, and restart the
    game. Updating the graphics driver helps too.

A message about OpenGL, or a black window:
    update the graphics driver (from NVIDIA, AMD or Intel's website, or
    Windows Update). The game needs OpenGL 3.3.

The Mac says "Play on Mac" can't be opened:
    see step 3. Or open the Terminal app and type (with your folder):
      cd ~/Downloads/Larsons-Game
      java -jar larsons-game.jar

Start over with fresh settings:
    delete the "config" folder inside the Larsons-Game folder.

Have fun!
